item.title: The e-scooter isn't new – London was zooming around on Autopeds a century ago
item.description:
📝 Lady Florence Norman 1916 (street background expanded) These were the Autoped, an American import that was once popular enough to regularly appear in the newspapers before vanishing seemingly without a trace. Several noted that the owners were switching to a car instead. It seems that the British weather might have killed off the Autoped.
🔗 Read more: https://www.ianvisits.co.uk/articles/the-e-scooter-isnt-new-london-was-zooming-around-on-autopeds-a-century-ago-86263/

item.title: AMD entered the CPU market with reverse-engineered Intel 8080 clone 50 years ago
item.description:
📝 Agreement with IntelIn 1976, AMD was presented with another great opportunity to profit from its clone of Intel's 8080. Am9080 chips had a significantly smaller die than the Intel 8080 that they copied. Intel’s 8080 processor SKUs were never produced with clock speeds above 3.
🔗 Read more: https://www.tomshardware.com/pc-components/cpus/amd-first-entered-the-cpu-market-with-reverse-engineered-intel-8080-clone-50-years-ago-the-am9080-cost-50-cents-apiece-to-make-but-sold-for-usd700
